analysis.hypothesis: The reference model can be reproduced by splitting it into three custom ops: embedding lookup (gather), transpose, and average pooling. The embedding lookup and average pooling will be implemented as custom CUDA/C++ kernels in later stages; model_new.py only calls these custom ops. The transpose can be handled as a view with custom op or simply as a stride manipulation; but per restrictions, only custom ops are allowed for computations, so a view/reshape may be acceptable if it is not a computational op. However, to be safe, we design a transpose custom op that may later be optimized to a view. The contract must match all custom extension calls in model_new.py.
